core.scope: Full current core suite, including torrent listing, hash verification, bounded bencode parsing and authentication classification

native.scope: Cache promotion, account isolation, quota guard, durable manual files, storage failures, reader scheduling, network gates, progress and prefetch continuity

UI.scope: Quiet downloads, save queue, torrent list and system export cancellation, detail clearance, four aligned library headers, offline reading and rolling prefetch

implementation_limits.page_to_image_hints: RAM only, account and cache-epoch scoped, at most 1024; after restart disk reuse requires resolving the same image URL
implementation_limits.offline_saving: Independent copies; existing single-image queue; no browse-cache capacity or 64 MB file cap applied to manual downloads
implementation_limits.BT: List and public seed/magnet export only; no in-App engine or background BT service

not_exercised: Real-site download speed and quota response
Live torrent payload retrieval and external downloader completion
Physical device UI and account operations
Actual response of the previously reported single gallery
